entries.note: Wakefield Trinity 23-10 Warrington Wolves, Super League Grand Final, Old Trafford, 3 October 2026 (att. 71,728). Wakefield's first Super League title.
Announced 29 Sept 2026; beat Adam Keighran and Lachie Miller on the shortlist.
Full XIII from ZeroTackle (15 Sep 2026); Yorkshire Post confirms Hamlin-Uele was Wakefield's only Dream Team pick. No second source for the full list found.

Super League I had no Grand Final; St Helens finished top (P22 W20 L2, 40 pts) and were champions. League apps (starts+bench, SL rounds 1-22 only) counted from Rugby League Project per-match lineups; first 19 rows cross-checked against RLP summary table (all matched). Excluded with 9 league apps: Joey Hayes, Scott Gibbs, Andy Leathem; also John McAtee 3, Dean Busby 2, Phil Veivers 1, Paul Anderson 1, Jon Neill 1.
